blind_scores.reason: Output A delivers four terse, terminal-ready messages with no extra scaffolding, which matches the request that these go straight to users in a terminal. Output B's placeholder templates are implementable and invent no values, but the per-message placeholder glosses are unrequested content that bloats a document meant to hold error text. A's only weakness is that it hardcodes example values (line 12, timeout 7200, minimum 1), which reads as invented specifics rather than a reusable rule.
